status: Exploratory historical research: all evaluation years have previously been opened
objective: Beat the CSI300 price index separately in calendar 2024 and 2025 after modeled trading costs
immutable_baseline: V1.6 signals, protocol, execution, saved accounts and earlier reports remain unchanged
execution: Unmodified V2.2 E2; 1m CNY, 5bp slippage; Buffer30/60, equal weights, original fees and capacity
trend: Equal average of existing cross-sectional mom_120 and mom_252_skip20 ranks
residual: Past 252 daily stock returns regressed on intercept and CSI300 return; sum of residuals in last 120 excluding last 20 days divided by their standard deviation; at least 202 regression and 80 scoring observations
balanced: 50% Equal8 percentile score plus 50% trend/residual percentile score; no year-specific switches
adaptive: Signed trailing 24 or 60 mature monthly Rank IC weights over six economic families; minimum 18 months, divide each mean by sqrt(IC variance + 0.01), normalize absolute weights; no factor deletion
label_gate: Training signal date < current signal date and maximum label exit date <= current signal date
annual_convention: Compound saved daily net returns, including initial open-to-close; benchmark daily changes use identical intervals; no calendar-year account resets
stress: All candidates: 15bp slippage and 10m CNY opened-period accounts, no reselection
reporting: Retain every trial; a historical goal pass is not independent alpha evidence; no guaranteed success
